script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: WHO AM I?

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

A bustling coffee shop. JANE (30s) sits alone, staring at her laptop. She's a successful marketing executive, but she feels unfulfilled. She orders a coffee and looks around, observing the diverse customers.

JANE (V.O.)
(voiceover)
Everyone here has a story. But what's mine?

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - LATER

Jane's cluttered living room. She's surrounded by boxes. She's moving. She takes out an old photo album.

JANE (V.O.)
(voiceover)
My life's been a blur of success. But who am I, really?

INT. WOMEN'S SHELTER - DAY

Jane volunteers at a women's shelter. She meets LUCY (40s), a survivor of domestic abuse. They connect over their shared experiences of feeling lost and unfulfilled.

LUCY
(smiling)
It's never too late to find yourself.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - AFTERNOON

Jane meets RAJ (20s), a charismatic artist. They strike up a conversation about identity and art.

RAJ
Identity is a journey, not a destination.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - EVENING

Jane paints for the first time. She experiments with colors and brush strokes.

JANE (V.O.)
(voiceover)
I've spent my whole life trying to fit in. But what if I just be myself?

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Jane attends an art exhibition. She sees Raj's art and is inspired. She approaches him.

JANE
Your art resonates with me. I want to help you share it with the world.

RAJ
(smiling)
That's all I ever wanted.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

Jane sits in her favorite spot, with a newfound sense of purpose. She looks around, a smile on her face.

JANE (V.O.)
(voiceover)
I'm not just a successful marketing executive. I'm an artist, a volunteer, a survivor. And most importantly, I'm me.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - LATER

Jane continues to paint, surrounded by her growing collection of artwork. She looks content.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
